'''Ratter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunter who hunted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] for sport on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Ratter was part of a gang of trandoshans that hunt captives for sport on Wasskah, where Jedi Padawans were to be hunted by Ratter and his gang. After two of the captives, [[Katt Mol/Legends|Katt Mol]] and [[Lika/Legends|Lika]], were killed, Ahsoka and the remaining Padawans stormed the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|Trandoshan floating fortress]], along with the freed Wookiee captive [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Ratter personally fought Chewbacca while the surviving Padawans wreaked havoc on the fortress and eventually got the upper hand, but he was ultimately killed when [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]] whacked him across the back with his own rifle, making him lose his concentration and allowing Chewbacca to throw him over the edge of the fortress.

==Talents and abilities==
Ratter was a skilled pilot of the [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod/Legends|MSP80 Pteropter]] and was proficient with [[Trandoshan blaster/Legends|blasters]]. He was also highly skilled in unarmed combat, having almost killed Chewbacca in a prolonged hand-to-hand fight.
